InputBoundary: Read-only access to the exact governed versioned object under inspection, its contemporaneously declared identity/version metadata, and any bounded comparison identities supplied for distinguishability inspection.

EvidenceBoundary: Governed object identity; inspected object provenance; version-identifier field or location; observed version value; presence/non-empty determination; ambiguity determination; attribution evidence; supplied comparison identities where applicable; distinguishability determination; failure reason where applicable; contemporaneous inspection record.
